meta.title: Seahawks at Raiders
meta.td_note: Market = the DraftKings anytime TD price quoted by ESPN on Nov 13. Only players with a quoted price get a call, and nobody listed as questionable gets one. Confirm the price in your own book first: the call only holds at the price shown or longer.

weather.note: Fixed roof, so weather is not a factor.

low_conf.LV: Fernando Mendoza has 8 pass attempts for the Raiders this season, so their numbers are low confidence.
low_conf.SEA: Sam Darnold has not practised this week, so the Seahawks quarterback is not certain.

notes: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold missed Week 9 and has not practised this week (ribs). If he is ruled out, Drew Lock starts.
Raiders rookie Fernando Mendoza now tops the depth chart after Kirk Cousins left.
